pattern: user asks to set something aside
experience: The user asks mid-task to park a follow-up for later; it belongs on the thread's Parked list, not in the reply or a new thread.
rule: t3_park: only what the user asked to set aside, or a follow-up worth their attention later.

pattern: delegated child parks on the user's list
experience: A delegated child parked its follow-ups on the user's list instead of handing them to its parent, which owns the work (session-board/DOT-151: only the main conversation parks).
rule: Only the main thread parks; a delegated child puts follow-ups in its report to its parent.
